about.title: About Pegah
about.heroIntro: Pegah began its journey in 2022 with one simple idea: a holiday should feel easy, honest and affordable. Today we plan trips across Bangladesh for families, couples, teams and anyone who wants to travel well for less.
about.storyBody: We started small, planning trips for friends and families who wanted someone dependable to handle the details. Word spread, and the trips grew into corporate tours, family holidays and honeymoon packages. Through every season we have kept one promise: tell the truth about prices, and stand by our travellers from booking until they are home.

timeline.y2022: Pegah starts its journey, planning tours across Bangladesh.
timeline.firsts: We introduce corporate tours, family tours and honeymoon packages — and pioneer travel gift cards.
timeline.today: Still working with honesty and sincerity, and making holidays affordable for everyone.
